name: simple_fsm_bench
description: A small benchmark intended to test models' ability to learn and reason about simple finite-state machines from examples. Tasks typically require predicting state transitions or whether an input sequence is accepted by an FSM, emphasizing algorithmic/generalization behavior rather than natural-language understanding. It is commonly used for diagnostic experiments on sequence generalization and compositionality.
reputation: A niche, research-focused benchmark used for probing algorithmic/generalization properties of sequence models; modest adoption in the algorithmic reasoning community.
